content.comment_body: Hello, I am aware this topic has been discussed multiple times, but I would like clarification. I have a question regarding which SD card type is best suited for use with [product_name] [version_no]. For instance, I am considering a SanDisk Ultra microSDHC Class 10 16GB card—will this work? Thank you in advance for any responses.

I have used various microSD cards from several brands, with different speed classes and capacities, and they all worked with [product_name]. The microSD card you mentioned (SanDisk Ultra microSDHC Class 10 16GB) has also worked for me. However, please note: The card should be fully formatted with FAT32, not just quick formatted.

analysis.insight_summary: The user requests confirmation regarding compatible SD card types for [product_name] [version_no], with a focus on third-party microSDHC options. Responses indicate a wide range of microSD cards will function properly if formatted with FAT32, and a full format (not quick format) is necessary for reliable operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects common third-party SD cards to work reliably with [product_name] [version_no] and seeks clear recommendations on compatibility requirements and best usage practices.
